name: Crowley Holt Terminals (Gloucester Terminal) - Gloucester City NJ

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (39.903121,-75.122743) land at the terminal — confirmed correct. 160 Essex Street is the Pier 8 & 9 Warehouse (solar-powered, 25M cu ft refrigerated, 100+ dock doors) within the Holt-operated Gloucester Marine Terminal. Identified via satellite (solar-roofed warehouse complex on the Delaware River) and Street View (signed TRUCK ENTRANCE / GATE).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed — Street View shows a posted 'TRUCK ENTRANCE' sign and a 'GATE' sign at the east entrance off Essex/King Street; a gate building and cone-managed gate lanes are visible (sv2/sv4). Satellite z20 shows a gate booth structure and a gate barrier arm across the lane.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small staffed gate building sits at the truck-entrance lanes (dark structure visible in z20 satellite and in Street View). Marine terminal under MTSA security. remoteGs = false.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Pier 8 & 9 refrigerated warehouse alone has 100+ dock doors per Holt documentation; the terminal complex carries well over 50 dock doors. Band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Open paved yard holds breakbulk cargo, parked trailers, and rows of chassis/equipment; estimated 25-50 drop trailers.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail tracks serve the terminal complex (rail/road bridge crosses the property; rail access into the Port of Philadelphia complex). railServed = true.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: multiple large solar-roofed warehouses (Pier 8&9 plus northern warehouse blocks), breakbulk yard, piers.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Truck gate fronts a street with adjacent residential development; limited stacking before the gate can push a queue toward the road.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved gate apron with multiple lanes and unused width.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Approximately 2 in / 2 out at the gate, cone-managed — counts are estimates, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; flagged uncertain.
